title: Smart Data Models - ERA EVR - VehicleAuthorisation
description:
Vehicle Authorisation for Placing on the Market (era:VehicleAuthorisation's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): (15) the decision issued by the authorising entity based on a reasonable assurance that the applicant and the entities involved in the design,
manufacture, verification and validation of the vehicle have fulfilled their respective obligations and responsibilities in order to ensure conformity with essential
requirements of the applicable legislation or to ensure conformity with the authorised type enabling that the vehicle may be placed on the market and may be used safely in the
area of use according to the conditions for use and other restrictions, when applicable, specified in the vehicle authorisation and in the vehicle type authorisation; Inherits attributes from era:Permission (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VehicleAuthorisation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

permissionStatus.description: Property. the status of the Permission, from a controlled Vocabulary, expressing how it evolves from being drafted to being valid and eventually possibly revoked/withdrawn. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

permits.description: Property. the process, activity, role or other scope which the Permission allows to the Requesting Body to execute or hold Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

requestedIn.description: Relationship. aiming to be enabled to act as covered by the Permission and its conditions, by issuing Target type (Request) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

submittedIn.description: Relationship. The submission of a permission or evidence to a case Target type (Case) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

valid.description: Relationship. valid during a certain time Target type (Interval) is not published as its own SDM model yet.
